subject: Reference concierge: Gartner technical + exec call with Brightleaf
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Gartner wants Brightleaf as reference — need concierge 

Chloe,

Quick one — Leah Patel at Gartner reached out and would like Brightleaf on a combined 30min call (15m exec + 15m technical) for an upcoming quadrant mention. Brightleaf was a reference for us last year but Legal requested an NDA then; this time Gartner wants a short technical readout and an exec quote.

Can you:
- Confirm Brightleaf is still willing (Samir is our CX contact).
- Send the case study draft & NDA and offer a couple of times next week (they asked for Wed/Thu windows).
- Handle any redlines so this doesn't stall.

Attaching a draft case study and the NDA template Gabriel in Legal suggested. Ben

[Attachment: redwood-case-study-draft.pdf (2 pages)]
[Attachment: NDA-Brightleaf-draft.pdf (1 page)]

-----
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gartner wants Brightleaf as reference — need concierge

Thanks Ben — looping Marissa from Advocacy to own the coordination with Brightleaf. Marissa, quick context: Gartner wants a 30m reference call that includes an exec (Samir or their Head of Product) plus a technical engineer who can speak to integration and latency/cost wins. They specifically asked for a 15m exec overview + 15m technical deep-dive.

Plan:
1) I’ll send Samir the case study draft + NDA and propose two slots on 22/23 Nov.
2) If they need the NDA redlined, we’ll get Legal looped (Gabriel).
3) Post-call: we’ll share a cleaned case study and a 1-paragraph exec quote for Gartner.

Marissa — can you also confirm whether we want to offer a short sandbox access for the tech portion? That helps with the technical detail Gartner likes.

Chloe

-----Original Message-----
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kahn <samir.k@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Quick call request from Gartner (Leah Patel) — Brightleaf reference

Samir — hope you’re well. Leah Patel from Gartner has asked if Brightleaf can participate in a short reference call for an upcoming analyst note. The ask is: 30 minutes total (15m exec + 15m technical). Gartner typically wants: 1) a high-level ROI/impact story from an exec 2) a technical discussion about integration, latency, and cost tradeoffs (15 minutes).

We value Brightleaf’s time — attached is a draft of the case study we’d share with Gartner and our standard NDA for this kind of request. If you’re open, would you be available either:
- Wed, 22 Nov between 10:00–12:00 PT
- Thu, 23 Nov between 13:00–15:00 PT

If those don’t work, send two windows that do and we’ll loop Gartner in. Also, please CC someone from your legal team if they want to review the NDA.

Attachments: redwood-case-study-draft.pdf, NDA-Brightleaf-draft.pdf

Best,
Chloe Martin
Customer Advocacy Lead | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

[Attachment: redwood-case-study-draft.pdf]
[Attachment: NDA-Brightleaf-draft.pdf]

-----Original Message-----
From: Samir Kahn <samir.k@brightleaf.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@brightleaf.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick call request from Gartner (Leah Patel) — Brightleaf reference

Hi Chloe — thanks for reaching out. Happy to help — we’re proud of the work with Redwood.

A few quick items from Legal (cc’d): they prefer to redline the NDA rather than sign the template as-is. Also, for the technical discussion, we’d like to ensure no PHI specifics are discussed; a high-level architecture and latency/throughput numbers are fine if anonymized.

Availability: Wed 22 Nov 10:30–11:00 PT works for Samir and our Head of Infra (Priya Rao). If Gartner needs an alternate, Thu 23 Nov 13:30–14:00 PT is also possible.

Can you send Leah the preferred slot + the redline-friendly NDA?

Thanks — Samir
Director of Customer Reliability | Brightleaf Health
samir.k@brightleaf.com | +1 617-555-2244

-----Original Message-----
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Leah Patel <leah.patel@gartner.com>
Cc: Samir Kahn <samir.k@brightleaf.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 07:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Gartner reference request — proposed slot & NDA process

Leah — thanks for the quick turnaround. Brightleaf confirmed availability for Wed 22 Nov 10:30–11:00 PT. They’ve asked that Legal review/redline the NDA (cc’d: legal@brightleaf.com). We’ve attached the case study draft for your review; Brightleaf asked that any PHI or customer-identifying datasets be redacted in public excerpts — note in the draft where we’ve anonymized the sample logs.

We propose the following: Leah to run the 30m call (10:30–11:00 PT 22 Nov). Gartner to provide a short list of questions for exec + tech (we’ll share a suggested list if helpful). Post-call we’ll circulate a cleaned case study and a 1-paragraph exec quote for Gartner approval.

Calendar invite and drive folder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-brightleaf-gartner-call
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCaseStudyDraft

If Legal needs a contact from our side for NDA redline negotiations, loop Gabriel in (legal@redwood.com).

Best,
Chloe Martin
Customer Advocacy Lead | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-case-study-draft.pdf]
[Attachment: NDA-Brightleaf-draft.pdf]
[Attachment: calendar-invite-20271122.ics]

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 11:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reference concierge: Gartner technical + exec call with Brightleaf

All set — call is on the calendar for 22 Nov 10:30–11:00 PT. I’ll own the pre-read and question set; suggestion below for Gartner: 3 exec questions (impact, org goals, ROI) + 4 tech questions (integration, latency, batch/caching strategy, fallback behavior). I will prepare a 1-page pre-read we’ll share with both Gartner and Brightleaf tomorrow morning.

Also prepping a short thank-you gift process for advocacy participants (Brightleaf is eligible for a small research stipend). I’ll track approval with Finance and confirm the stipend and payment process after the call.

Marissa Cole
Customer Advocacy Manager | Redwood Inference

[-- end thread --]
